The <b>{{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is a consumable product that provides the user with a small bonus towards certain techpoints. All of these books can be purchased from the [[Astrologer]], at either tier 2 or 3, while the lesser variety can be crafted at a [[Random text generator|Random Text Generator]] in the [[alchemy lab|Alchemy Lab]].
